The '''father''' of [[Kendara Farlion]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and resided in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Javul Charn's father|one of his former comrades]], the man took in his friend's children, the future [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] and her brother [[Ayx]].<ref name="Shadow Games" />
